name: Quadruped Quad Stretch
steps: Start on all fours on the floor with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Bend one knee to lift your heel, then reach back with the opposite hand and grasp your ankle.
Draw your heel gently toward your glute while keeping your abs lightly braced so your lower back stays neutral.
Hold the stretch steadily with calm breaths on one side, then release your foot gently and switch legs.
tips: Place a folded towel beneath your supporting knee if you need extra cushioning on a hard floor.
Keep your hips level and avoid collapsing your weight into your supporting shoulder.
